=== Page 5 === (confidence 0.97)
RESTRICTED
STANDARD FORM NS. 64
TO
A-H - General Hilldring
DATE: May 15, 1947
FROM
A-H - C. C. Hilliard CH.
SUBJECT:
U. S. Comercial Banking Facilities, and Operation of Foreign
Banks in Japan and Korea.
Submitted herewith, with recommendation for your approval,
is the attached draft cable to SCAP on the above subject.
Background information relative to the attachment is as
follows: SCAP has requested that the National City Bank of
New York be authorised to function as a depository of dollar
proceeds of Japanese exports, and to render global export-import
banking services to SCAP. Since the NCB is now operating in
Tokyo, on the basis of limited banking services, it would be a
convenience for SCAP to use the head office and other branches
of the NCB for the above mentioned purposes. However, this
raises the question of possible discrimination among American
banks. Therefore, the attached draft cable requests SCAP's
comments as a basis for SWNCC action. The attachment also
outlines the procedure to be followed by American banks in
connection with application for the establishment of branches
in Japan and Korea. An important advice in this draft cable
is that the Chase National Bank, New York, is requesting
permission to establish branches in Tokyo and Seoul. SCAP is
5-1547
requested to survey his present and prospective baniing require-
ments and to report fully in order to facilitate review in
Washington of thi& subfect so that a restatement of existing
United States policy may be made in the light of recent
developments.
The attachment has the concurrence of the War Department
(Mr. Foster) and of the Treasury Department (Mr. Lipsman).
AM
Fauter
to
Attachment.
9:25
47
Rhoned
awh
RESTRICTED
